column2:
SUMMARY: Main Grades to aim for are Grade 6 and Grade 17 where specific hero pools are removed. If main goal is to get better tier heroes, then resources are better off spent to aim for Grade 6/17 rather than in-between these Grades.

Hero units selected as materials for rerolling will NOT be consumed until choice confirmation.

Once a hero you want appears, it is a CHANCE to get it; not guaranteed. If a hero you want appears, you confirm your selection and you will have the stated chance to get one of the 5 units shown.

For Grade 6: 
Need 381pts
To remove R heroes & for L++ heroes to enter the pool

Cost-efficient combinations: 
[2x R + 3x L] or [3x R + 2x L+]
column18:
For Grade 17: 
Need 801pts
To remove L heroes from the pool

Cost-efficient combinations: 
[3x L + 2x  L+] or [1x R + 4x L+]
